Roll the listed success chance. A successful summon normally lasts 1 hour; a summoned creature cannot use its own summon ability for 1 hour and grants no experience when defeated. Use the listed equivalent spell level for Concentration and dispelling. The summoner's feature names the eligible creature and any exception.

This reusable record defines shared conversion behavior. Individual actors carry exact printed exceptions and totals.

system.source: World of Warcraft: Monster Guide, pp. 197
